content: WebAssembly integer instructions are fully specified with no implementation-defined behavior, so integer-only C++ compiled with Emscripten produces bit-identical results to native. Floats differ across x87/SSE/NEON/wasm in low bits. 128-bit integer math in wasm is 2-7x slower than native (wide-arithmetic proposal); Emscripten compiler-rt ships __multi3/__udivti3/ashlti3/lshrti3 so __int128 compiles today despite the 2017 issue #5630.
